title: Private Full-Day Circle Island Guided Small-Group up to 6 (Se habla Español)
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: Come and experience the top sightseeing tour on Oahu. This tour features Oahu's natural wonders and cultural sites. Be captivated by the unique beauty and the dramatic history found at every turn. You will be with an amazing local tour guide. This tour is perfect for people that like to be in small groups. The morning sun slowly warms the sandy beaches as your guide takes you on a journey through the history of the island. Private tours available. Please contact us for details.
